integrity_notes: Primary model formulas and Holevo interpretation are fully attributed to arXiv:2610.40638v1. The new proof concerns the sharp all-parameter entropy optimum. Reproducibility checks and remaining literature-priority uncertainty are reported without any external certification.
scientific_limitations: Ideal noiseless Bell-reset transverse Ising dimer; single-qubit reset-age Holevo information, fixed step duration; no many-body, noisy-device, or non-Bell generality. The overall constant is a supremum at p down to zero, not an attained finite-p value.
title: A sharp single-qubit age-information ceiling for Bell-reset Ising dimers
